download_mindcube_data: download the MindCube dataset from HuggingFace to a specified data directory
download_mindcube_force: force re-download the MindCube dataset from HuggingFace even if data already exists
load_mindcube_prompts: load MindCube prompts and images from the downloaded data directory into a dictionary
review_download_function: review the download function to understand how MindCube data is extracted from a zip archive
review_load_prompts_function: review the load_prompts function to understand how JSONL samples are parsed and images are copied
